collection.title: Peugeot Partner 2008 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Peugeot Partner 2008 - 2018 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Peugeot Partner which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
